title: IDLE zeroes both sticks and the roll and pitch rates ramp to zero
derivation: A Viper-like scan-class-neutral ship in IDLE with flightRoll 0.97, flightPitch -0.71 and arbitrary starting sticks. behaviour_idle sets stick_yaw 0, stick_roll 0 and stick_pitch 0 (the ship is neither a station nor a buoy, ShipEntity.m:3710-3720) and calls applySticks, so a rate with a zero stick moves by 2 dt = 1/60 (roll) or 4 dt = 1/30 (pitch) per tick (accuracy 2, no doubling; a zero stick never counts as opposing, 7025-7028) and snaps onto 0 when within one step. flightRoll(k) = max(0, 0.97 - k/60): 58.2 steps, so tick 58 holds 0.00333 and tick 59 is 0. flightPitch(k) = min(0, -0.71 + k/30): 21.3 steps, so tick 21 holds -0.01 and tick 22 is 0. Closed forms.

title: IDLE does not stop the ship: the speed keeps ramping toward the current desiredSpeed
derivation: behaviour_idle only manages attitude; processBehaviour then runs applyAttitudeChanges and applyThrust for any behaviour that does not turn them off (ShipEntity.m:2634-2637), so an IDLE ship at flightSpeed 100 with desired_speed 150 keeps accelerating at 4/3 per tick: flightSpeed(k) = min(150, 100 + 4k/3), reaching 150 mid-step at tick 38 (37.5 steps). Position is the sum of dt * speed_j (the move uses the ramped speed): (100 k + (4/3) k(k+1)/2) / 120 up to tick 37, then 150/120 per tick.

title: performStop sets STOP_STILL, desiredSpeed 0 and frustration 0, then the ship settles and stops
derivation: A ship in IDLE at flightSpeed 82 with desired_speed 120, frustration 7.0, flightRoll 0.47, flightPitch -0.47 and non-zero sticks takes assign perform STOP_STILL. performStop sets behaviour = STOP_STILL, desired_speed = 0 and frustration = 0 (ShipEntityAI.m:466-471; no draw, so tick-0 checks may name these three fields). behaviour_stop_still zeroes the three sticks and calls applySticks, so the rates settle by 1/60 (roll) and 1/30 (pitch) per tick: flightRoll(k) = max(0, 0.47 - k/60) (28.2 steps), flightPitch(k) = min(0, -0.47 + k/30) (14.1 steps). The speed decays at 4/3 per tick through decrease_flight_speed (82 / (4/3) = 61.5 steps: tick 61 holds 0.6667, tick 62 is 0). The nose also pitches while the pitch rate settles, so position is not checked here (it is not a closed form). Closed forms.
